blocks.source: Canto XIX
blocks.translation: Canto XIX

blocks.source: O Simon mago, o miseri seguaci
blocks.translation: O Simon Magus, O forlorn disciples,

blocks.source: che le cose di Dio, che di bontate
blocks.translation: Ye who the things of God, which ought to be

blocks.source: deon essere spose, e voi rapaci
blocks.translation: The brides of holiness, rapaciously

blocks.source: per oro e per argento avolterate,
blocks.translation: For silver and for gold do prostitute,

blocks.source: or convien che per voi suoni la tromba,
blocks.translation: Now it behoves for you the trumpet sound,

blocks.source: però che ne la terza bolgia state.
blocks.translation: Because in this third Bolgia ye abide.

blocks.source: Già eravamo, a la seguente tomba,
blocks.translation: We had already on the following tomb

blocks.source: montati de lo scoglio in quella parte
blocks.translation: Ascended to that portion of the crag

blocks.source: ch’a punto sovra mezzo ’l fosso piomba.
blocks.translation: Which o’er the middle of the moat hangs plumb.

blocks.source: O somma sapïenza, quanta è l’arte
blocks.translation: Wisdom supreme, O how great art thou showest

blocks.source: che mostri in cielo, in terra e nel mal mondo,
blocks.translation: In heaven, in earth, and in the evil world,

blocks.source: e quanto giusto tua virtù comparte!
blocks.translation: And with what justice doth thy power distribute!

blocks.source: Io vidi per le coste e per lo fondo
blocks.translation: I saw upon the sides and on the bottom

blocks.source: piena la pietra livida di fóri,
blocks.translation: The livid stone with perforations filled,

blocks.source: d’un largo tutti e ciascun era tondo.
blocks.translation: All of one size, and every one was round.

blocks.source: Non mi parean men ampi né maggiori
blocks.translation: To me less ample seemed they not, nor greater

blocks.source: che que’ che son nel mio bel San Giovanni,
blocks.translation: Than those that in my beautiful Saint John

blocks.source: fatti per loco d’i battezzatori;
blocks.translation: Are fashioned for the place of the baptisers,

blocks.source: l’un de li quali, ancor non è molt’ anni,
blocks.translation: And one of which, not many years ago,

blocks.source: rupp’ io per un che dentro v’annegava:
blocks.translation: I broke for some one, who was drowning in it;

blocks.source: e questo sia suggel ch’ogn’ omo sganni.
blocks.translation: Be this a seal all men to undeceive.

blocks.source: Fuor de la bocca a ciascun soperchiava
blocks.translation: Out of the mouth of each one there protruded

blocks.source: d’un peccator li piedi e de le gambe
blocks.translation: The feet of a transgressor, and the legs

blocks.source: infino al grosso, e l’altro dentro stava.
blocks.translation: Up to the calf, the rest within remained.

blocks.source: Le piante erano a tutti accese intrambe;
blocks.translation: In all of them the soles were both on fire;

blocks.source: per che sì forte guizzavan le giunte,
blocks.translation: Wherefore the joints so violently quivered,

blocks.source: che spezzate averien ritorte e strambe.
blocks.translation: They would have snapped asunder withes and bands.

blocks.source: Qual suole il fiammeggiar de le cose unte
blocks.translation: Even as the flame of unctuous things is wont

blocks.source: muoversi pur su per la strema buccia,
blocks.translation: To move upon the outer surface only,

blocks.source: tal era lì dai calcagni a le punte.
blocks.translation: So likewise was it there from heel to point.

blocks.source: «Chi è colui, maestro, che si cruccia
blocks.translation: “Master, who is that one who writhes himself,

blocks.source: guizzando più che li altri suoi consorti»,
blocks.translation: More than his other comrades quivering,”

blocks.source: diss’ io, «e cui più roggia fiamma succia?».
blocks.translation: I said, “and whom a redder flame is sucking?”

blocks.source: Ed elli a me: «Se tu vuo’ ch’i’ ti porti
blocks.translation: And he to me: “If thou wilt have me bear thee

blocks.source: là giù per quella ripa che più giace,
blocks.translation: Down there along that bank which slopes more gently,

blocks.source: da lui saprai di sé e de’ suoi torti».
blocks.translation: From him thou’lt know his errors and himself.”

blocks.source: E io: «Tanto m’è bel, quanto a te piace:
blocks.translation: And I: “What pleases thee, to me is pleasing;

blocks.source: tu se’ segnore, e sai ch’i’ non mi parto
blocks.translation: Thou art my Lord, and knowest that I depart not

blocks.source: dal tuo volere, e sai quel che si tace».
blocks.translation: From thy desire, and knowest what is not spoken.”

blocks.source: Allor venimmo in su l’argine quarto;
blocks.translation: Straightway upon the fourth dike we arrived;

blocks.source: volgemmo e discendemmo a mano stanca
blocks.translation: We turned, and on the left-hand side descended

blocks.source: là giù nel fondo foracchiato e arto.
blocks.translation: Down to the bottom full of holes and narrow.

blocks.source: Lo buon maestro ancor de la sua anca
blocks.translation: And the good Master yet from off his haunch

blocks.source: non mi dipuose, sì mi giunse al rotto
blocks.translation: Deposed me not, till to the hole he brought me

blocks.source: di quel che si piangeva con la zanca.
blocks.translation: Of him who so lamented with his shanks.

blocks.source: «O qual che se’ che ’l di sù tien di sotto,
blocks.translation: “Whoe’er thou art, that standest upside down,

blocks.source: anima trista come pal commessa»,
blocks.translation: O doleful soul, implanted like a stake,”

blocks.source: comincia’ io a dir, «se puoi, fa motto».
blocks.translation: To say began I, “if thou canst, speak out.”

blocks.source: Io stava come ’l frate che confessa
blocks.translation: I stood even as the friar who is confessing

blocks.source: lo perfido assessin, che, poi ch’è fitto,
blocks.translation: The false assassin, who, when he is fixed,

blocks.source: richiama lui per che la morte cessa.
blocks.translation: Recalls him, so that death may be delayed.

blocks.source: Ed el gridò: «Se’ tu già costì ritto,
blocks.translation: And he cried out: “Dost thou stand there already,

blocks.source: se’ tu già costì ritto, Bonifazio?
blocks.translation: Dost thou stand there already, Boniface?

blocks.source: Di parecchi anni mi mentì lo scritto.
blocks.translation: By many years the record lied to me.

blocks.source: Se’ tu sì tosto di quell’ aver sazio
blocks.translation: Art thou so early satiate with that wealth,

blocks.source: per lo qual non temesti tòrre a ’nganno
blocks.translation: For which thou didst not fear to take by fraud

blocks.source: la bella donna, e poi di farne strazio?».
blocks.translation: The beautiful Lady, and then work her woe?”

blocks.source: Tal mi fec’ io, quai son color che stanno,
blocks.translation: Such I became, as people are who stand,

blocks.source: per non intender ciò ch’è lor risposto,
blocks.translation: Not comprehending what is answered them,

blocks.source: quasi scornati, e risponder non sanno.
blocks.translation: As if bemocked, and know not how to answer.

blocks.source: Allor Virgilio disse: «Dilli tosto:
blocks.translation: Then said Virgilius: “Say to him straightway,

blocks.source: “Non son colui, non son colui che credi”»;
blocks.translation: ‘I am not he, I am not he thou thinkest.’”

blocks.source: e io rispuosi come a me fu imposto.
blocks.translation: And I replied as was imposed on me.

blocks.source: Per che lo spirto tutti storse i piedi;
blocks.translation: Whereat the spirit writhed with both his feet,

blocks.source: poi, sospirando e con voce di pianto,
blocks.translation: Then, sighing, with a voice of lamentation

blocks.source: mi disse: «Dunque che a me richiedi?
blocks.translation: Said to me: “Then what wantest thou of me?

blocks.source: Se di saper ch’i’ sia ti cal cotanto,
blocks.translation: If who I am thou carest so much to know,

blocks.source: che tu abbi però la ripa corsa,
blocks.translation: That thou on that account hast crossed the bank,

blocks.source: sappi ch’i’ fui vestito del gran manto;
blocks.translation: Know that I vested was with the great mantle;

blocks.source: e veramente fui figliuol de l’orsa,
blocks.translation: And truly was I son of the She-bear,

blocks.source: cupido sì per avanzar li orsatti,
blocks.translation: So eager to advance the cubs, that wealth

blocks.source: che sù l’avere e qui me misi in borsa.
blocks.translation: Above, and here myself, I pocketed.

blocks.source: Di sotto al capo mio son li altri tratti
blocks.translation: Beneath my head the others are dragged down

blocks.source: che precedetter me simoneggiando,
blocks.translation: Who have preceded me in simony,

blocks.source: per le fessure de la pietra piatti.
blocks.translation: Flattened along the fissure of the rock.

blocks.source: Là giù cascherò io altresì quando
blocks.translation: Below there I shall likewise fall, whenever

blocks.source: verrà colui ch’i’ credea che tu fossi,
blocks.translation: That one shall come who I believed thou wast,

blocks.source: allor ch’i’ feci ’l sùbito dimando.
blocks.translation: What time the sudden question I proposed.

blocks.source: Ma più è ’l tempo già che i piè mi cossi
blocks.translation: But longer I my feet already toast,

blocks.source: e ch’i’ son stato così sottosopra,
blocks.translation: And here have been in this way upside down,

blocks.source: ch’el non starà piantato coi piè rossi:
blocks.translation: Than he will planted stay with reddened feet;

blocks.source: ché dopo lui verrà di più laida opra,
blocks.translation: For after him shall come of fouler deed

blocks.source: di ver’ ponente, un pastor sanza legge,
blocks.translation: From tow’rds the west a Pastor without law,

blocks.source: tal che convien che lui e me ricuopra.
blocks.translation: Such as befits to cover him and me.

blocks.source: Nuovo Iasón sarà, di cui si legge
blocks.translation: New Jason will he be, of whom we read

blocks.source: ne’ Maccabei; e come a quel fu molle
blocks.translation: In Maccabees; and as his king was pliant,

blocks.source: suo re, così fia lui chi Francia regge».
blocks.translation: So he who governs France shall be to this one.”

blocks.source: Io non so s’i’ mi fui qui troppo folle,
blocks.translation: I do not know if I were here too bold,

blocks.source: ch’i’ pur rispuosi lui a questo metro:
blocks.translation: That him I answered only in this metre:

blocks.source: «Deh, or mi dì: quanto tesoro volle
blocks.translation: “I pray thee tell me now how great a treasure

blocks.source: Nostro Segnore in prima da san Pietro
blocks.translation: Our Lord demanded of Saint Peter first,

blocks.source: ch’ei ponesse le chiavi in sua balìa?
blocks.translation: Before he put the keys into his keeping?

blocks.source: Certo non chiese se non “Viemmi retro”.
blocks.translation: Truly he nothing asked but ‘Follow me.’

blocks.source: Né Pier né li altri tolsero a Matia
blocks.translation: Nor Peter nor the rest asked of Matthias

blocks.source: oro od argento, quando fu sortito
blocks.translation: Silver or gold, when he by lot was chosen

blocks.source: al loco che perdé l’anima ria.
blocks.translation: Unto the place the guilty soul had lost.

blocks.source: Però ti sta, ché tu se’ ben punito;
blocks.translation: Therefore stay here, for thou art justly punished,

blocks.source: e guarda ben la mal tolta moneta
blocks.translation: And keep safe guard o’er the ill-gotten money,

blocks.source: ch’esser ti fece contra Carlo ardito.
blocks.translation: Which caused thee to be valiant against Charles.

blocks.source: E se non fosse ch’ancor lo mi vieta
blocks.translation: And were it not that still forbids it me

blocks.source: la reverenza de le somme chiavi
blocks.translation: The reverence for the keys superlative

blocks.source: che tu tenesti ne la vita lieta,
blocks.translation: Thou hadst in keeping in the gladsome life,

blocks.source: io userei parole ancor più gravi;
blocks.translation: I would make use of words more grievous still;

blocks.source: ché la vostra avarizia il mondo attrista,
blocks.translation: Because your avarice afflicts the world,

blocks.source: calcando i buoni e sollevando i pravi.
blocks.translation: Trampling the good and lifting the depraved.

blocks.source: Di voi pastor s’accorse il Vangelista,
blocks.translation: The Evangelist you Pastors had in mind,

blocks.source: quando colei che siede sopra l’acque
blocks.translation: When she who sitteth upon many waters

blocks.source: puttaneggiar coi regi a lui fu vista;
blocks.translation: To fornicate with kings by him was seen;

blocks.source: quella che con le sette teste nacque,
blocks.translation: The same who with the seven heads was born,

blocks.source: e da le diece corna ebbe argomento,
blocks.translation: And power and strength from the ten horns received,

blocks.source: fin che virtute al suo marito piacque.
blocks.translation: So long as virtue to her spouse was pleasing.

blocks.source: Fatto v’avete dio d’oro e d’argento;
blocks.translation: Ye have made yourselves a god of gold and silver;

blocks.source: e che altro è da voi a l’idolatre,
blocks.translation: And from the idolater how differ ye,

blocks.source: se non ch’elli uno, e voi ne orate cento?
blocks.translation: Save that he one, and ye a hundred worship?

blocks.source: Ahi, Costantin, di quanto mal fu matre,
blocks.translation: Ah, Constantine! of how much ill was mother,

blocks.source: non la tua conversion, ma quella dote
blocks.translation: Not thy conversion, but that marriage dower

blocks.source: che da te prese il primo ricco patre!».
blocks.translation: Which the first wealthy Father took from thee!”

blocks.source: E mentr’ io li cantava cotai note,
blocks.translation: And while I sang to him such notes as these,

blocks.source: o ira o coscïenza che ’l mordesse,
blocks.translation: Either that anger or that conscience stung him,

blocks.source: forte spingava con ambo le piote.
blocks.translation: He struggled violently with both his feet.

blocks.source: I’ credo ben ch’al mio duca piacesse,
blocks.translation: I think in sooth that it my Leader pleased,

blocks.source: con sì contenta labbia sempre attese
blocks.translation: With such contented lip he listened ever

blocks.source: lo suon de le parole vere espresse.
blocks.translation: Unto the sound of the true words expressed.

blocks.source: Però con ambo le braccia mi prese;
blocks.translation: Therefore with both his arms he took me up,

blocks.source: e poi che tutto su mi s’ebbe al petto,
blocks.translation: And when he had me all upon his breast,

blocks.source: rimontò per la via onde discese.
blocks.translation: Remounted by the way where he descended.

blocks.source: Né si stancò d’avermi a sé distretto,
blocks.translation: Nor did he tire to have me clasped to him;

blocks.source: sì men portò sovra ’l colmo de l’arco
blocks.translation: But bore me to the summit of the arch

blocks.source: che dal quarto al quinto argine è tragetto.
blocks.translation: Which from the fourth dike to the fifth is passage.

blocks.source: Quivi soavemente spuose il carco,
blocks.translation: There tenderly he laid his burden down,

blocks.source: soave per lo scoglio sconcio ed erto
blocks.translation: Tenderly on the crag uneven and steep,

blocks.source: che sarebbe a le capre duro varco.
blocks.translation: That would have been hard passage for the goats:

blocks.source: Indi un altro vallon mi fu scoperto.
blocks.translation: Thence was unveiled to me another valley.
